arguments.sql:
SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_spent_usd
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.card_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM cards c WHERE c.credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000)
arguments.explanation: Sums the amount of every transaction made on cards with a credit limit above $20,000, converted from cents to dollars.
assumptions: All transactions on those cards are included, whether or not they carry a fraud label.
Negative amounts (56,900 rows in the data, meaning undocumented) are included as recorded, so they reduce the total; they are not treated as refunds or removed.
The whole data period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 is included, since no date range was specified.
